script:
We have to keep two questions separate. Was a check reasonable after a message suggesting someone might end their life? It could have been. Angela has said she was afraid for Sav and knew calling might cost their friendship.

But Sav says the call went ahead after both she and Sara Beth told Angela she had calmed down. Sav believed the way it was handled was connected to the online dispute, and that she was being taught a lesson.

That is Sav's interpretation. I cannot know Angela's private motive from the accounts we have.

What I can do is follow what happened to information from that night. Because the story didn't end when the officer left.

Within weeks, Angela was describing disappointment with people she considered friends. On September 7, she named Sine and me while explaining why she believed others had failed her.

The next day, on September 8, Angela began a broadcast in which she announced that she was going to post private relationship messages.

And that is where the personal crisis Sav had described became part of something much bigger.

By the beginning of September, private conversations were already making their way into public Spaces. And people were nervous about getting involved.

The Space was what the audience heard. The back channels—private messages, group chats, and Discord rooms—were where people said things they never expected that audience to hear.

On September 2, I talked about screenshots I believed Angela had posted. I asked another host to hide them. He wouldn't—and the reason he gave says something about how powerful her reputation had become.

You'll hear his refusal described in my own words, followed by another speaker who starts to explain why he wanted no part of the conflict.

“Because they told her secrets and they can never—”

He stops there. The rest of that thought isn't recorded. But the fear in the conversation is hard to miss.

By then, even other hosts were afraid of what might happen if they crossed Angela. Six days later, something happened in my own room that Angela would use to explain why she was releasing even more private messages.
